clips.text: Hello. This is a pixel reel. A short cartoon that explains one thing. I'm Peter, and I'll be reading it to you.
You know the feeling. A long letter lands on the mat. Or someone sends a link you really must read. And your heart sinks a bit.
So don't read it. Watch it instead. A pixel reel takes the bits that matter, and turns them into a little film.
Each scene has one idea. A few big, plain words. And a picture to go with them. That's all there is to take in.
And you're in charge. Pause me whenever you like. Go back a bit. Watch it twice. I really don't mind.
To get one, just ask Claude. Say what you want explained. Claude writes the scenes, and I do the talking.
It's good for letters and bills. For plans, and how things work. Even homework. Anything you would rather watch than read.
Now for the small print. There isn't much. It's free. Only people with your link can watch. And after thirty days, your reel is gone.
So. Your turn. Add Pixel Reel to Claude, and ask for a reel about anything you like. Thanks for watching.
